main_body: Bonsai-style pine: three separate foliage pads on a leaning brown trunk
top_band: none as a flat surface. Column x=23 runs dark green outline (row 2), mid and light greens with the lightest at rows 7-8, then dark green (rows 10-11). The trunk runs from row 20 to row 44. Both are organic masses, not a flat top over a front face.
evidence: This is an organic tree. The foliage pads are rounded volumes with lighter tufts on their upper-middle parts and darker undersides, and the trunk is a tapered cylinder. There are no flat horizontal surfaces or architectural faces for the 3/4 contract to fail. No receding side faces and no flat front-elevation panel are drawn. The silhouette reads as a tree seen from slightly above.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 11 distinct colours and a median of 5 per tile, against 108-109 per tile and 427-567 colours for the references. The foliage uses about 4 greens (L 38, 69, 88, 110) and the trunk about 4 browns, so the ramps are shallow next to the references' 5-6 steps. The outline is dark green beside the leaves and dark brown beside the trunk, not neutral (0% near-neutral edge pixels), and the 5x5 flat-fill coverage is 0%. The pads have some pixel clumping. Even so, the leaves have none of the per-leaf highlights, varied clusters or bark grain the references carry, so it looks much thinner and flatter than them.
